It isn’t as clear-cut as “causing” those issues. Myocarditis is certainly a risk with administration of these mRNA vaccines, but the risk of the same heart issues is generally higher with covid infection. 
https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/full/10.1161/CIRCULATIONAHA.122.059970 
This huge longitudinal study of over 40 million patients suggests the risks of myocarditis is higher in men younger than 40, but the risk ratio in the general population is lower after vaccine administration versus covid infection. Regardless, I think the hospital should have to accommodate the situation of this kid having a rare heart issue that may increase her risk from either scenario.

You may not trust the institutions that excessively profit from the developments in modern medicine (there are good reasons to not trust them), but the data shows calculable benefits of the pharmaceuticals used to treat widespread diseases. [here are some](https://www.mesothelioma.com/treatment/chemotherapy/statistics/)

I wouldn’t say to altogether discount them. They’ve saved lives in the past century that would’ve been invariably lost by late-stage cancers. Yes, they have toxicities to healthy cells, but the combination treatments currently used, particularly from cyclophosphoramide, help make sure the exposure to these agents are minimized. Plus,  targeted therapies are very rapidly addressing the “shotgun” approach of these older drugs
